name: Parametric enclosure template
sourceContract: Produce design.json with exactly externalMm:{x,y,z} and wallMm. All values are finite positive millimetres. This reference adapter creates a rectangular open-top enclosure, with a uniform floor and side wall. It does not implement apertures, bosses, hinges or arbitrary shapes; use another adapter for those. Match accepted mechanical interfaces. Do not generate Python or files under outputs/.
limitations: Reference rectangular enclosure adapter only; every output requires independent geometry validation.
